reviews.x: I’ve only just started using these, but the price was right, they are effective at removing makeup & dirt, they are refreshing, and I have had no adverse reactions to them.  I will update as I continue using them should anything change. UPDATE: 3 days later my near-perfect skin is COMPLETELY broken out in tiny pimples everywhere!  Of course not everyone’s is sensitive to the same things, but this is really awful!  Now I’m stuck with 5 packs of them unless the seller will do the right thing and l

reviews.t: and don’t have a good “feel”. Almost feel dry rather than moist with ...
reviews.x: These facial wipes are smaller than my preferred brand, and don’t have a good “feel”.  Almost feel dry rather than moist with some kind of cleansing agent.  I ordered because of the price - quite disappointed & won’t order again.

These wipes work great with getting my makeup off and they're a good value but for some reason they make my eyes burn. I've never had issues with makeup wipes before and I very rarely have sensitivities to anything but I don't think I'll be buying these again.

reviews.t: I was really disappointed in these wipes
reviews.x: I was really disappointed in these wipes. They are pretty dry, irritated my eyes terribly and left a lot of make up behind..
Terrible at removing mascara and burns your eyes. Sucked it up and used the whole box but will not repurchase.

reviews.t: haven't used any other makeup removers since
reviews.x: omg i got a sweet email from the customer service manager, asking if i liked the product. maybe it's automated i'm not sure, and probably because i've reordered these i think 3 times already, but honestly either way it was a very nice email as for the actual makeup wipes, i haven't used any other means of removing my makeup since i started buying these. i have dry, sensitive skin that's prone to breakouts and these haven't made me breakout once, nor dry me out and they remove everything on my fa

reviews.t: Best for me on minimal makeup days
reviews.x: These makeup wipes are okay, but I've used better. They do help to get the initial makeup off but I always need to wash the lingering makeup off with a second, third or even fourth wipe. Usually I end up going back to my miceller water. I wear waterproof eye makeup and these don't get it off completely on their own. They do seem to be made of a thicker material than wipes I've used in the past so they can stand up to heavy duty cleansing. I think these would work best for me on minimal makeup da

I know some reviews said it dried their skin too much - maybe because I have oily skin, this was never an issue for me. Getting a bunch of small packets, I could leave them throughout the house to do whenever - bathroom, bedroom and even living room. They are super soft never hurt when I wipe my eyes. I hate strong scented makeup removers - which this one doesn't have any strong odors!

reviews.t: Fine for the skin, rough on the eyes
reviews.x: I'm not sure why, but these make my eyes burn as if I'm washing them with soap- I don't have terribly sensitive eyes either. If you use a separate eye makeup remover this should work for you, but if you're looking for a wipe that does it all, maybe skip on this one.  I will say, it DOES get my mascara off really well... I'd just rather keep my eyeballs in the process, you know?
These make-up remover wipes are much larger than any I have used before. Removes eye shadow and mascara without making my eyes sting. I like them so much I put them on auto ship.
Hardly even will remove my concealer. Definitely doesn't remove my eyeliner or mascara at all. I hate that I wasted my money on 6 packages of these.
I am obsessed with these makeup wipes!!! They are amazing, so fresh, clean, efficient, and buying in bulk is the best thing ever!!!!!!
The cloth is very thin, it burns my eyes and it has parabens in it but claims to be "natural"? So disappointed
These cleansing wipes clean my skin, remove my makeup and no redness afterwards.  Very gentle on my skin!
Cheaper than Neutrogena and work just as well. They smell good and soften skin.
HAPPY WITH  THIS, GREAT PRICE AND CLEANS OFF MAKEUP  AS EXPECTED.

reviews.t: Pretty pricey and a huge letdown
reviews.x: I have used a lot of make up remover towelettes in my day. My most recent or the Biore face wipes.  Pretty pricey and a huge letdown. They burn my eyes and whenever they were crossed my lips they left a very disgusting chemically taste and smell. These wipes far surpass that brand! They are cheaper but the quality is all around better. The scent is that of a cucumber non-chemical smell.  It is very gentle on the face and does not make me feel like I'm smothering chemical all over my face. It tak

Dont be fooled these wipes are good sized. I am liking the feeling of clean without wiping again and again. Just the right amount of moisture and light scent. My face is not dry or irritated after use. I've tried many different wipes and the one I really enjoyed was too expensive. Now I'm happy and not paying a lot. 5/2019- continue to use nightly and still pleased with moisturizing and moistness of towelettes. I have plenty yet, but absolutely will reorder.

reviews.t: as it is challenging taking off more stubborn make up like mascara. When you take the towelette out the ...
reviews.x: It would definitely be a 5 stars review if the towelettes were just a little more wet, as it is challenging taking off more stubborn make up like mascara. When you take the towelette out the package they almost feel half dry... and I am having this happen from multiple packages so I don’t think it’s a one package fluke; that said they still do a pretty good job removing makeup without having all of the harsh chemicals.

You can't beat the price with a stick! I found a travel size of a different brand in the grocery store (like 10 wipes) for $5.49. This does the job. Use around the eyes is a bit more uncomfortable than I've experienced with other products. Minor stinging that won't prevent me from continued used.

reviews.t: And they smell nice. My face is not greasy or dry after ...
reviews.x: These wipes work really well. And they smell nice. My face is not greasy or dry after using them.  They do make my eyes feel watery immediately after use, but that’s true of most makeup removers, and they don’t sting, so better on that count than most other similar products.

These wipes work great, especially for the great price. I read a review that said they were too dry. I find them fine, but I also read in product description that you can add a few drops of water to package. Hope this will help if you find them dry.

reviews.t: Very good wipes at a good price.
reviews.x: I am especially pleased with the makeup remover packs.  They clean thoroughly & quickly.  My eye makeup is usually very difficult to wipe off.  These wipes are the best I've used to get it off without tugging & pulling the delicate eye area.

reviews.t: Great make-up remover for normal-dry skin
reviews.x: These work well as make-up remover, but leave just a little bit too much behind. Since they are billed as facial cleansers in addition to make-up remover, I just wanted to mention this in case anyone else has oily-ish complexion issues.

Absolutely love. They make my skin feel refreshed after I clean the makeup off my face and they don’t burn my eyes when I use them to take eye makeup off. So much cheaper than the ones I used before, and so much better.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that these wipes burn or irritate their eyes.
Several reviewers find the wipes too dry and ineffective at removing makeup, especially mascara and eyeliner.
Reviewers frequently praise the value and price of these wipes.
Some reviewers say the wipes are gentle on their skin and effectively remove makeup without redness.
A few reviewers experienced skin irritation or breakouts after use.
